南京有 50 多所高校、80 多万在校生，整座城市的节奏是围着学生转的。对留学生: Nanjing has 50-plus universities and 800,000-plus students. The city runs on that clock. For internationals the mix is rare: dense 985 campuses, mid-range living costs, metro to almost every campus, and the old town under plane trees is actually beautiful. The catch is summer heat at "four furnaces" level, and no central heating in winter.
12 条地铁线，起步价 2 元，多数校区门口就有站: 12 metro lines. Base fare 2 yuan. Most campuses have a stop at the gate.
明城墙、玄武湖、栖霞山，周末不出城也有地方去: Ming city wall, Xuanwu Lake, Qixia Mountain. You can leave campus on a weekend without leaving the city.
到上海高铁 1 小时 10 分，到杭州 1 小时 20 分: High-speed rail to Shanghai in 1 hour 10 minutes. Hangzhou in 1 hour 20.
冬天没有暖气，宿舍靠空调，这一点务必提前知道: No heating in winter. Dorms run on air-con. Know this before you come.
地铁 S1 号线转 1 号线，末班 22:00 左右: Metro S1 to Line 1. Last train around 22:00.
南京南站发车，班次密到不用提前订: Trains leave from Nanjing South. So frequent you don't need to book ahead.
开学前一周内，按录取通知书上的日期: In the week before term starts, on the date on your admission notice
6 张两寸白底照片: 6 two-inch photos on a white background
照片在学校旁边的照相馆拍最保险，他们知道尺寸要求，20 元左右给你电子版加纸质版: Safest to shoot photos at the studio next to campus. They know the size. About 20 yuan for digital plus prints.
把护照首页、签证页、入境章各复印 5 份，接下来两周每个窗口都要。: Copy the passport bio page, visa page, and entry stamp. Five sets each. Every window wants them for the next two weeks.
JW201/JW202 表丢了补办要回原发证机关，务必单独收好。: If you lose the JW201/JW202, you have to go back to the office that issued it. Keep it in its own sleeve.
入住后 24 小时内（是入住后，不是入境后；住校内通常由学校代办，住校外必须自己: Within 24 hours of moving in (moving in, not landing. On campus the school usually files it. Off campus you file it yourself.)
换住址、换护照要重新登记。但持居留证件住在同一个经常住所，在证件有效期内出境再回: Change of address or passport means register again. If you hold a residence permit, live at the same usual address, and leave and return while it is valid, the official rule is you do not register again.
住酒店的话酒店会自动帮你登记，但那张单子只对酒店那几天有效。: Hotels register you automatically. That slip only covers the hotel stay.
学校可以作为「留宿人」代你申报，住校内一般就是这么办的，先问国际处。: The school can file as your host. That's the usual on-campus path. Ask the international office first.
缺这张登记表，居留许可窗口会让你回去补。法律是给予警告并可以并处 2000 元以: Without this form, the residence-permit window sends you back. The law is a warning and a possible fine up to 2,000 yuan. It is not an automatic 2,000.
报到后第一周，越早越好: First week after registration. Earlier is better.
前一晚 10 点后禁食: No food after 10pm the night before
在国内做过体检的话，带上带公章的英文报告可以申请免检，但通过率看当天窗口。: If you already did a health check in China, bring the stamped English report and you can ask to skip it. Approval depends on the window that day.
9 月开学季排队能到两小时，7:30 到门口排能省一半时间。: In September, queues can hit two hours. Arrive at 7:30 and you can cut that in half.
《境外人员体格检查记录验证证明》另收 60 元，办居留许可要用这张，体检当天一起: The "Verification Certificate of Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" is another 60 yuan. You need it for the residence permit. Get it on health-check day.
入境后 30 天内，签证到期前务必办完: Within 30 days of entry, and before the visa expires.
学校国际处一般会在 9 月组织统一办理，跟着走最省事，别自作主张单独跑。: The international office usually runs a group filing in September. Follow that group. Don't freelance it.
办理期间护照会被收走 7-10 个工作日，这段时间不能坐飞机和高铁，提前安排好行: They hold your passport for 7-10 working days. No flights or high-speed rail in that window. Plan trips around it.
逾期居留每天罚款 500 元，上限 10000 元，严重的会影响下次签证。: Overstay is 500 yuan a day, capped at 10,000. A serious case can hit the next visa.
学生套餐常见是 39-59 元/月含 30GB 流量，办卡时直接说「学生套餐」。: Student plans are usually 39-59 yuan/month with 30GB. At the counter, just say "student plan."
号码一定要用自己的护照实名，室友代办的号在后面办银行卡时会卡住。: The number must be under your own passport. A SIM a roommate opens for you will jam later when you open a bank account.
拿到手机号之后，报到后两周内: After you have a phone number, within two weeks of registration
开卡时一定要同时开通「手机银行」和「短信通知」，否则后面绑支付宝要再跑一趟。: When you open the account, turn on mobile banking and SMS alerts in the same visit. Skip them and you come back to bind Alipay.
有些支行要求居留许可下来才给开卡，先打电话问清楚再去。: Some branches wait for the residence permit before they'll open an account. Call first.
银行卡到手当天: The day the bank card is in your hand
支付宝里搜「Tour Pass」可以先用外卡应急，但长期还是要绑中国卡。: Search "Tour Pass" in Alipay to use a foreign card in a pinch. Long term, bind a Chinese card.
实名时姓名顺序按护照机读区来填（姓在前），填反了要人工申诉。: For real-name signup, use the passport MRZ order (surname first). Flip it and you file a manual appeal.
一卡通要绑定支付宝自动充值，不然食堂刷到余额不足很尴尬。: Bind the campus card to Alipay auto-top-up. Hitting zero at the canteen is awkward.
顺手办校园网账号，宿舍有线和 Wi-Fi 用的是同一套账号。: Open the campus-network account while you're there. Dorm ethernet and Wi-Fi share the same login.
保单是电子版，下载 PDF 存好，看病报销和续签都用得上。: The policy is digital. Save the PDF. You'll need it for clinic claims and visa renewals.
自己在国外买的保险几乎都不被认可，别浪费钱重复买。: Insurance you bought abroad is almost never accepted. Don't pay twice.
CSC 中国政府奖学金、江苏省政府奖学金、南大校长奖学金三条线都招留学生，3 月: CSC, the Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship, and the NJU Presidential Scholarship all take international students. Most deadlines fall in March.
秋季入学 12 月至次年 4 月，春季入学 9 月至 11 月: Fall intake: December to April the next year. Spring intake: September to November.
南大本科生和大部分留学生都在仙林。校区大到骑车穿行要 15 分钟，宿舍、食堂、图: NJU undergrads and most internationals sit at Xianlin. The campus is big enough that a bike ride across it takes 15 minutes. Dorms, canteens, library, gym are all from the last decade or so. Line 2 "NJU Xianlin Campus" is at the north gate. 40 minutes into town. The catch is the east suburbs. Past university town at night, it goes quiet.
十几所大学挤在一起，全是学生、奶茶店和自习室: A dozen universities packed together. Students, milk tea, and study rooms.
走路或骑车 10 分钟到校门: 10 minutes to the gate on foot or by bike
寒暑假整片区域会空掉，很多店直接关门。: The whole area empties in winter and summer break. A lot of shops just close.
新小区，安静，环湖跑步很舒服: New compounds. Quiet. Lake-loop runs are easy.
骑车 15 分钟，或地铁 2 号线一站: 15 minutes by bike, or one stop on Line 2
南京真正的市中心，商场、酒吧、live house 都在这: Nanjing's real downtown. Malls, bars, and live houses.
通勤每天来回一个半小时，第二学期基本都会后悔。: Commute is 1.5 hours round trip. By semester two most people regret it.
有专门的清真窗口，米饭管够，阿姨手抖看运气。: There's a dedicated halal window. Rice is unlimited. Portion size is luck.
南门外美食街: Food street outside the south gate
拌面和烤肉是留学生食堂之外的第二根支柱，老板认人。: Mixed noodles and grilled meat are the second pillar after the international canteen. The owner knows faces.
披萨、汉堡、日料都有，想家的时候来这。: Pizza, burgers, Japanese. Come here when you miss home.
App 下单 30 分钟送到宿舍楼下，牛羊肉比菜场干净。: Order on the app. It arrives downstairs in 30 minutes. Beef and lamb are cleaner than the wet market.
期末座位难抢，但店员英语最好，办卡不懂可以问。: Seats are scarce near finals. Staff English is the best of the lot. If the card signup confuses you, ask.
开到 22:30，三楼靠窗一排是全校最好的位置。: Open until 22:30. The window row on the 3rd floor is the best seat on campus.
羽毛球要提前一天在企业微信上抢场，健身房刷校园卡免费。: Book badminton a day ahead on WeCom. Gym is free with the campus card.
感冒发烧够用，大问题转鼓楼医院；带上医保卡能报一部分。: Fine for a cold or a fever. Bigger problems go to Drum Tower Hospital. Bring the medical-insurance card and you can claim part of it.
指着手机照片说「就这个」成功率比说中文高。: Point at a photo on your phone and say "this one." It works better than Chinese.
所有快递都在这取，短信里的取件码就是全部流程。: Every parcel is picked up here. The SMS pickup code is the whole process.
2 号线南大仙林校区站，北门出去 200m: Line 2, NJU Xianlin Campus station. 200m from the north gate.
秋天看红叶，本地人周末都去: Red leaves in autumn. Locals go on weekends.
留学生规模大、来源国多，几乎每个语种都能找到同胞: Large international cohort, many countries. You can find someone in almost every language.
地铁站在校门口，进城不用换乘: Metro at the gate. Into town with no transfer.
宿舍和教学楼都是新的，空调、热水、电梯齐全: Dorms and teaching buildings are new. Air-con, hot water, elevators. All there.
学校国际处会统一组织居留许可，第一次几乎不用自己跑: The international office batches the first residence permit. You almost never go alone the first time.
校区离市中心 20 公里，晚上想临时出去玩成本很高: Campus is 20 km from downtown. A spontaneous night out is expensive.
冬天没有暖气，12 月到 2 月宿舍靠空调硬扛: No central heating in winter. From December to February the dorm runs on the air-con.
部分专业课只有中文授课，选课前一定要问清楚: Some major courses are Chinese-only. Ask before you register.
校区太大，从宿舍到最远的教学楼骑车也要 12 分钟: Campus is huge. Dorm to the farthest teaching building is still 12 minutes by bike.
不会中文能活下去吗？: Can you get by without Chinese?
在校内没问题，国际处和留学生辅导员都能用英语。出了校门就要靠手机翻译，点菜、看病: On campus you're fine. The international office and international counselors can work in English. Off campus you need phone translation. For ordering, clinics, and bank cards, screenshot the Chinese phrases first.
宿舍能保证吗？可以住校外吗？: Is a dorm guaranteed? Can you live off campus?
第一年基本都能分到宿舍，双人间每月约 1000 元。校外住宿要先向学校备案，并在: First year you almost always get a dorm. Doubles are about 1,000 yuan a month. Off-campus housing needs a school filing, then police registration within 24 hours.
校园网能上国外网站吗？: Does campus Wi-Fi reach foreign sites?
学校为留学生和科研提供国际线路，图书馆和实验室访问学术站点没问题。日常社交软件的: The school gives internationals and labs an international route. Library and lab access to academic sites is fine. For everyday social apps, ask someone on campus. It varies a lot by campus.
留学生校外兼职需要学校同意并在居留许可上加注「勤工助学」，没有加注私自打工会影响: Off-campus part-time work needs school approval and a "work-study" note on the residence permit. Working without it can hurt the renewal. On-campus RA or TA work is the stable path.
工科专业的 CSC 名额多，土木、建筑、电子信息全英文硕士项目每年都招。: Engineering gets a lot of CSC seats. English-taught master's in civil engineering, architecture, and electronic information recruit every year.
东大的本科低年级和大量研究生都在九龙湖。建筑、土木、电子是招牌，全英文授课的硕士: SEU underclassmen and a lot of graduate students sit at Jiulonghu. Architecture, civil engineering, and electronics are the flags. English-taught master's programs are the fullest set in Nanjing. The campus is in Jiangning. Line 3 gets you there. About 45 minutes into the city. The layout is tidy. A lap of the lake is a running staple.
校区自成一体，出门就是湖和体育场: Campus is its own world. Lake and stadium right outside.
周边商业配套少，想吃点不一样的基本靠外卖。: Little around campus. Anything different is delivery.
江宁最热闹的商圈，商场、电影院、餐厅都在这: Jiangning's busiest commercial area. Mall, cinema, restaurants.
新开发区，房子新价格低: New development zone. New buildings, low prices.
二楼有清真窗口，三楼小炒贵一点但好吃很多。: Halal window on the 2nd floor. Stir-fry on the 3rd costs more and tastes a lot better.
全中国最可靠的清真选项，指菜单第一行就行。: The most reliable halal option in the country. Point at the first line of the menu.
日用品够用，进口货要去百家湖的大超市。: Daily goods are covered. Imports: a big supermarket in Baijiahu.
最便宜的美式，写论文的人一坐一天。: Cheapest Americano. Thesis people sit all day.
建筑本身就是打卡点，自习座位得用 App 预约。: The building is a photo stop. Study seats need an app booking.
游泳馆要另买票，学生 15 元一次。: The pool is a separate ticket. 15 yuan a session for students.
开药方便，拍片子要去江宁医院。: Easy for prescriptions. Imaging means Jiangning Hospital.
江宁唯一像样的夜生活，周五晚上留学生局常在这。: Jiangning's only real nightlife. Friday international gatherings often land here.
3 号线诚信大道站，或校车到地铁口: Line 3, Chengxin Avenue station. Or take the campus shuttle to the metro.
江宁离机场比主城近，这是个隐藏优势: Jiangning is closer to the airport than downtown. That's a hidden advantage.
校车免费，班次表贴在宿舍楼下: Campus shuttle is free. Timetable is posted downstairs in the dorm.
全英文授课的工科硕士项目多，不会中文也能顺利毕业: Lots of English-taught engineering master's programs. You can graduate without Chinese.
生活成本是南京主要高校里最低的一档: Living costs sit in the lowest band among Nanjing's main universities.
离禄口机场近，回国和出去旅行都方便: Close to Lukou Airport. Easy for going home and for trips.
校园新、绿化好，环湖跑道晚上灯很亮: Campus is new and green. The lake-loop track is well lit at night.
位置偏，进主城单程 45 分钟起: It's out of the way. One-way into the city starts at 45 minutes.
校区周边商业太少，第一个月会觉得很闷: Too little commerce around campus. The first month feels dull.
夜生活基本为零，想热闹要跑去百家湖或市区: Nightlife is basically zero. For a scene, go to Baijiahu or downtown.
食堂口味偏淡，重口味的人前两周会不适应: Canteen food runs mild. If you eat heavy, the first two weeks will feel off.
全英文项目真的全程不用中文吗？: Can you really skip Chinese the whole way in an English-taught program?
课程和论文可以，但生活里办卡、看病、租房还是要中文。学校有免费的中文课，第一学期: Courses and the thesis, yes. Cards, clinics, and rent still need Chinese. The school has free Chinese classes. Take them in semester one.
本科低年级和多数研究生在九龙湖，少数专业在市中心的四牌楼。录取通知书上会写清楚，: Underclassmen and most graduate students are at Jiulonghu. A few majors sit at Sipailou downtown. The admission notice says which. Free shuttle between the two.
第一个月会。留学生群体自己组织的活动很多，加入球队或社团是最快融入的方式。: The first month, yes. Internationals run a lot of their own events. A team or a club is the fastest way in.
科研用的国际线路学校有提供，具体权限由导师和实验室分配，入学后问师兄师姐最快。: The school provides an international route for research. Access is assigned by your supervisor and lab. Fastest answer after you arrive is a senior in the group.
国际中文教师奖学金（原孔子学院奖学金）覆盖大部分语言进修生和汉语国际教育硕士，江: The International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship (formerly Confucius Institute Scholarship) covers most language students and MTCSOL. Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship and CSC go mostly to degree students.
语言进修生每学期都收，秋季学位生 12 月至 5 月: Language students are admitted every term. Fall degree students: December to May.
南师大的语言生、交换生和汉语国际教育专业几乎都在随园。校区是 1923 年金陵女: NNU language students, exchange students, and Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages almost all sit at Suiyuan. The campus is the old 1923 Ginling College grounds. Green glazed tiles and plane trees. "One of China's most beautiful campuses" is not fluff. It's small enough to walk in 10 minutes. Out Ninghai Road you hit the Yihe Road mansion district and Shanghai Road cafes. 35 minutes on foot to Xinjiekou. The tradeoff is old dorms, few beds, no real sports ground, and nowhere left to build.
随园床位少，语言生和交换生被安排到校外公寓的很常见，那就必须自己去派出所登记，别: Suiyuan has few beds. Language and exchange students often get off-campus apartments. Then you register at the police station yourself. Don't assume the school files it.
民国公馆区，梧桐、小院、咖啡馆，租的都是老房子: Republican-era mansion district. Plane trees, courtyards, cafes. The rentals are old houses.
想住进电影里: Want to live inside a film still
老房子隔音差、没电梯、冬天漏风，看房时把空调和热水器都开一遍。: Old houses: thin walls, no elevator, drafts in winter. At the viewing, turn on the air-con and the water heater.
南大和南师大中间的学生街，酒吧、书店、深夜食堂: The student street between NJU and NNU. Bars, bookstores, late-night canteens.
临街的房子周五晚上很吵。: Street-facing rooms are loud on Friday nights.
老居民区，菜场和小饭馆便宜，住的多是本地家庭: Old residential area. Wet market and small restaurants are cheap. Mostly local families.
地铁 4 号线两站，或骑车 15 分钟: Line 4, two stops. Or 15 minutes by bike.
有清真窗口，15 元两荤一素；语言生 11:40 下课一起冲过去要排十分钟。: Halal window. 15 yuan for two meats and one vegetable. Language students get out at 11:40 and the queue is ten minutes.
宁海路校门外沿街: Along the street outside the Ninghai Road gate
全中国最可靠的清真选项，加个蛋 20 元，晚上 11 点还开着。: The most reliable halal option in the country. Add an egg, 20 yuan. Still open at 11pm.
出校门往东，上海路沿线: East of the gate, along Shanghai Road
十几家独立咖啡馆，南大南师大的人都在这写作业，点单指着图就行。: A dozen independent cafes. NJU and NNU people do homework here. Point at the picture to order.
广州路，地下车库改的书店: Guangzhou Road. A bookstore converted from an underground garage.
南京最有名的书店，咖啡区能坐一下午，周末人多得像景点。: Nanjing's most famous bookstore. The cafe can hold you all afternoon. Weekends feel like a tourist site.
上海路与汉口路交叉口一带: Around Shanghai Road and Hankou Road
南大留学生养出来的一片市场，汉堡、意面、墨西哥卷都有，老板多半会英语。: A strip NJU internationals keep alive. Burgers, pasta, burritos. Most owners speak English.
南京本地连锁，宁海路一带有好几家，买水果比便利店便宜一半。: A Nanjing chain. Several shops around Ninghai Road. Fruit is about half the convenience-store price.
十点以后是南大、南师大留学生的默认集合点，精酿 30-45 元一杯。: After 10pm this is the default meetup for NJU and NNU internationals. Craft beer 30-45 yuan a glass.
只有跑道和几个篮球场，想练器械要去校外健身房，月卡 150-200 元。: Just a track and a few basketball courts. For weights, go to an off-campus gym. Monthly card 150-200 yuan.
全省最好的三甲之一，有国际门诊但收费高一截；普通门诊先在公众号上预约再去。: One of the best Grade-A tertiary hospitals in the province. There is an international clinic, and it costs more. For the regular clinic, book on the WeChat account first.
校区小，快递点只有一个，双十一前后要排队。: Campus is small. One parcel point. Queues around Double 11.
4 号线云南路站上车，鼓楼站换 1 号线一站；天气好直接走，35 分钟: Board Line 4 at Yunnan Road, change to Line 1 at Gulou for one stop. In good weather, just walk. 35 minutes.
走 15 分钟到鼓楼站，1 号线直达: 15-minute walk to Gulou station. Line 1, no transfer.
1 号线到南京南站换 S1，行李多就打车，150 元左右: Line 1 to Nanjing South, then S1. With lots of luggage, take a taxi. About 150 yuan.
共享单车沿北京西路一路向东，湖边跑步和野餐都不要钱: Grab a shared bike east along Beijing West Road. Lakeside runs and picnics are free.
校区在鼓楼区正中，走路就能到上海路、颐和路，进新街口不用等地铁: Campus sits in the middle of Gulou District. Walk to Shanghai Road and Yihe Road. Xinjiekou without waiting for the metro.
语言生和交换生占比高，国际文化教育学院对零基础学生的流程很熟: Language and exchange students are a large share. The International College for Chinese Studies knows the zero-beginner process.
民国建筑加满园梧桐，秋天在校园里走一圈就值回机票: Republican-era buildings and a campus of plane trees. One autumn walk can feel like it paid for the flight.
南大鼓楼校区就在马路对面，两校的留学生活动基本互通: NJU Gulou campus is across the street. International events at both schools mostly mix.
宿舍是老楼，独卫和电梯都不能指望，热水器要错峰用: Dorms are old buildings. Don't count on a private bath or an elevator. Time the water heater off-peak.
校区太小，没有健身房和游泳馆，想运动得去校外花钱: Campus is tiny. No gym, no pool. Sport means paying off campus.
床位紧，语言生不一定能分到宿舍，很多人开学第一周就得找房: Beds are tight. Language students don't always get a dorm. A lot of people hunt housing in week one.
冬天没有暖气，老楼的窗户漏风，空调制热效果比新校区差得多: No heating in winter. Old-building windows leak. The air-con heat is far weaker than on a new campus.
零基础可以报语言班吗？: Can complete beginners join a language class?
可以，国际文化教育学院每学期都开零起点班，按入学测试分级。一学期学费 9000: Yes. The International College for Chinese Studies opens zero-beginner classes every term, placed by an entry test. About 9,000 yuan a semester, around 17,000 a year. You can switch levels in the first two weeks.
住不进宿舍怎么办？: What if you don't get a dorm?
学院会给一份合作公寓和中介的名单，上海路、宁海路一带一居室 2600-4000: The college gives a list of partner apartments and agents. Studios around Shanghai Road and Ninghai Road run 2600-4000 yuan. Within 24 hours of signing, take the contract and a copy of the landlord's ID to the police station. Don't sit on this step.
南师大本科生大部分在仙林校区，随园主要是研究生、语言生和部分文科院系。录取通知书: Most NNU undergrads are on Xianlin campus. Suiyuan is mostly graduate students, language students, and some humanities departments. The campus on your admission notice is the one you report to and study on. They are 20 km apart. Don't show up at the wrong one.
在随园学中文，进步会比其他学校快吗？: Will Chinese improve faster at Suiyuan than at other schools?
教材和课时差不多，差别在于随园出门就是市区，买菜、点单、坐车都是在用中文。想练口: Textbooks and class hours are similar. The difference is Suiyuan dumps you into the city. Buying groceries, ordering, and riding transit are all in Chinese. People who want speaking practice pick this campus. People who don't want to speak Chinese get tired here.
CSC「一带一路」专项、水利部和商务部的援外项目、江苏省政府奖学金是主力，全奖比: The main pots are CSC Belt and Road awards, Ministry of Water Resources and Ministry of Commerce aid programs, and the Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship. Full-ride rates are unusually high for Nanjing, but the seats cluster in water conservancy, civil engineering, and environment.
秋季入学 12 月至 4 月，CSC A 类要走本国使馆，1 月前就得动手: Fall intake: December to April. CSC Type A goes through your home embassy. Start before January.
河海是水利部背景的工科校，水利工程在各种学科排名里都是世界第一档，土木、环境、电: Hohai is an engineering school under the Ministry of Water Resources. Water conservancy ranks in the world top tier on the usual league tables. Civil engineering, environment, and electrical are strong too. Almost all internationals sit on Jiangning campus. More than half hold Chinese Government Belt and Road-type scholarships. Pakistani, Ethiopian, Kazakh, and Bangladeshi classmates are easy to find. The gate is metro S1 "Hohai University · Focheng West Road". Two stops to Nanjing South. 55 minutes to Xinjiekou. Weekends the campus is quiet enough to feel like a holiday.
CSC 奖学金的生活费只打到学校指定银行的账户，开卡前先问国际教育学院是哪家支行: CSC stipend only goes to the bank the school names. Ask the School of International Education which branch before you open an account. Wrong bank, and the first payment is a month late.
大学城边缘的居民小区，房子新、价格低，吃饭靠外卖和小超市: Residential blocks on the edge of university town. New buildings, low rent. Food is delivery and a small supermarket.
晚上九点后街上没什么人，小卖部也关得早。: After 9pm the street is empty. Kiosks close early too.
七八所高校围着方山，学生街、奶茶店、网吧，比河海门口热闹: Seven or eight universities ring Fangshan. Student street, milk tea, internet cafes. Busier than Hohai's gate.
骑车 15 分钟，或公交 3 站: 15 minutes by bike, or 3 bus stops
想认识其他学校的人: Want to meet people from other schools
江宁最成熟的商圈，商场、电影院、健身房都有: Jiangning's most built-out commercial area. Mall, cinema, and gym.
S1 到南京南站换 1 号线，35 分钟: S1 to Nanjing South, then Line 1. 35 minutes.
受不了大学城的安静: Can't stand how quiet university town is
每天通勤要换乘，赶早八很痛苦。: The daily commute needs a transfer. Making 8am class hurts.
留学生多，清真窗口是全校最长的队，13 元一份，周五中午去晚了就没了。: Lots of internationals. The halal window is the longest line on campus. 13 yuan a tray. Friday lunch, late means gone.
校门口沿佛城西路: Along Focheng West Road at the gate
新疆菜和兰州拉面都有，留学生多的地方清真选项从不缺，30 元吃饱。: Xinjiang food and Lanzhou noodles both exist. Anywhere internationals cluster, halal is not the problem. 30 yuan fills you.
日用品够用，进口货和香料要去百家湖的大超市或网购。: Daily goods are covered. Imports and spices: a big supermarket in Baijiahu, or order online.
App 下单 9.9 元起，是江宁校区唯一像咖啡馆的地方，想坐一下午还是去图书馆: Order on the app from 9.9 yuan. It's the only place on Jiangning campus that feels like a cafe. If you want to sit all afternoon, go to the library.
留学生借书要先去柜台激活账号，期末一楼 7 点前坐满。: Internationals activate the library account at the desk first. Before finals the 1st floor is full by 7.
板球是这里的国民运动，周日下午的场子被巴基斯坦和孟加拉同学包了；健身房刷卡免费。: Cricket is the national sport here. Sunday afternoon the pitch is Pakistani and Bangladeshi. Gym is free with your card.
配药、开转诊单在这，大病去江宁医院，打车 20 分钟。: Meds and referral slips are here. Serious cases go to Jiangning Hospital. Taxi 20 minutes.
包裹全在这，海运回国的行李也可以在这问顺丰。: Every parcel lands here. Ask SF Express here about sea-freight home too.
扫码 5 元一次，烘干机只有一楼有，周末下午最抢手。: Scan to pay, 5 yuan a load. Dryers are only on the 1st floor. Weekend afternoons are a fight.
S1 河海大学·佛城西路站两站到南京南站，换 1 号线: S1 Hohai University · Focheng West Road station. Two stops to Nanjing South, then Line 1.
S1 反方向直达机场，是南京所有校区里到机场最快的: S1 the other way goes straight to the airport. Fastest airport trip of any Nanjing campus.
S1 转 1 号线到鼓楼站再走 15 分钟，部分院系的答辩和讲座在老校区: S1 to Line 1 to Gulou, then 15 minutes on foot. Some departments hold defenses and talks on the old campus.
水利、土木、环境的全英文硕博项目多，导师带国际生的经验丰富: Lots of English-taught master's and PhD programs in water conservancy, civil engineering, and environment. Supervisors are used to international students.
全奖比例高，CSC 和一带一路专项名额集中在这里: Full-ride rate is high. CSC and Belt and Road seats cluster here.
留学生规模大，巴基斯坦、埃塞、哈萨克斯坦的学生会都很活跃，节日不愁没人过: Large international cohort. Pakistani, Ethiopian, and Kazakh student associations are active. Holidays are not lonely.
地铁 S1 在校门口，两站到南京南站，25 分钟到禄口机场: S1 at the gate. Two stops to Nanjing South. 25 minutes to Lukou Airport.
校区在江宁南部，进新街口单程 55 分钟起，还要换乘: Campus is in south Jiangning. One-way to Xinjiekou starts at 55 minutes, and you transfer.
几乎全是工科，校园文化偏理工，文艺活动少: Almost all engineering. Campus culture is STEM. Arts events are thin.
周边太安静，晚上九点以后校门外基本没店开着: Too quiet around here. After 9pm almost nothing outside the gate is open.
奖学金生集中意味着开学季行政窗口极度拥挤，报到排队两小时是常态: A pile of scholarship students means admin windows jam at the start of term. A two-hour registration queue is normal.
CSC 生活费什么时候到账？: When does the CSC stipend arrive?
一般报到、体检和银行卡都办完后的下个月 15 号前后到账，第一笔可能拖到 10: It usually lands around the 15th of the month after registration, the health check, and the bank card are done. The first payment can slip to late October. Open the account at the bank the School of International Education names. Wrong bank, and the money never arrives.
全英文项目的课真的全英文吗？: Are English-taught programs actually in English?
课件和考试是英文，但导师组会和实验室日常大量用中文。研究生第一年选一门中文课，两: Slides and exams are English. Supervisor meetings and lab life are mostly Chinese. Take a Chinese class in year one of the master's. By year two you can usually follow group meeting.
巴基斯坦和非洲学生多，会不会形成小圈子？: Lots of Pakistani and African students. Do they form a bubble?
会。同乡群体大是好事也是坏事，想练中文和认识中国同学的人要主动加入学院的社团和球: Yes. A big hometown crowd is both a plus and a trap. If you want Chinese and Chinese classmates, join a college club or a team on purpose.
本科生和大部分硕博在江宁，少数文科和商科在市区的鼓楼校区（西康路）。看录取通知书: Undergrads and most master's/PhD students are in Jiangning. A few humanities and business programs sit at Gulou campus downtown (Xikang Road). Read the campus on the admission notice. Metro between them is over an hour.
CSC 和江苏省政府奖学金都有，但涉及国防背景的专业不对留学生开放，申请前先在国: CSC and the Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship are both available. Majors with a defense background are closed to international students. Check this year's program list on the School of International Education website before you apply.
南理工从哈军工炮兵工程系一路演变过来，兵器、材料、机械、自动化是家底。校区在紫金: NJUST grew out of the artillery engineering department of the Harbin Military Engineering Institute. Weapons, materials, machinery, and automation are the family trade. The campus sits on the south slope of Purple Mountain. Across the road are Ming Xiaoling and the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum. Line 2 Xiaolingwei to Xinjiekou is 15 minutes. Best location among Nanjing's large campuses. Late March, February orchids cover the grounds and the city shows up to photograph them. Watch out: many majors are closed to international students, and most of the open ones are Chinese-taught.
报到时会核对你的专业是否在当年的留学生开放目录内，录取通知书和目录对不上的先去国: At registration they check whether your major is on this year's open list for internationals. If the admission notice and the list don't match, ask the School of International Education before you pay tuition.
老居民区加学生街，小饭馆和水果店多，房租不贵: Old residential blocks plus a student street. Lots of small restaurants and fruit shops. Rent is not high.
想离地铁近: Want to be near the metro
老小区没电梯，六楼的房子夏天很热。: Old compounds have no elevator. A 6th-floor unit is hot in summer.
更靠城里一点，卫岗牛奶的总部就在这，安静的老城东: A bit closer in. Weigang Milk's headquarters is here. Quiet old east-city.
地铁 2 号线两站，或骑车 12 分钟: Line 2, two stops. Or 12 minutes by bike.
想住得离市区近点: Want to live closer to downtown
城东的通勤住宅区，新小区多，价格比城里低一档: East-city commuter housing. Lots of new compounds. A step cheaper than downtown.
马群站是换乘站，早高峰地铁挤得上不去。: Maqun is a transfer station. Morning peak, you may not get on.
生活区，几栋食堂挨着: Living area. Several canteens in a row.
有清真窗口，13 元一荤两素；晚上九点后只剩一楼的面窗口。: Halal window. 13 yuan for one meat and two vegetables. After 9pm only the noodle window on 1F is left.
兰州拉面加新疆拌面，晚上 11 点还开着。: Lanzhou noodles and Xinjiang mixed noodles. Still open at 11pm.
赶早八前的续命站，星巴克店员英语能对付。: The life-support stop before 8am class. Starbucks staff English is enough.
日常够用，牛羊肉和进口货去新街口的大超市或网购。: Fine for daily stuff. Beef, lamb, and imports: a big supermarket in Xinjiekou, or order online.
座位多，但要在图书馆小程序上选座，早上 8 点放座秒空。: Lots of seats, but you grab one in the library mini program. At 8am they vanish.
游泳馆学生 15 元一次，羽毛球场要在企业微信抢，健身房刷校园卡免费。: Pool is 15 yuan a session for students. Badminton courts are grabbed on WeCom. Gym is free with the campus card.
小病开药够用，大病坐三站地铁到明故宫站的东部战区总医院。: Fine for a cold and a prescription. For something serious, three metro stops to Eastern Theater Command General Hospital at Ming Palace station.
学生价 30 元，先练好这句「剪短一点，不要太短」。: Student price 30 yuan. Practice this line: "a bit shorter, not too short."
取件码在短信里，寄大件回国找隔壁的顺丰点。: Pickup code is in the SMS. For big parcels home, the SF Express next door.
南京最集中的酒吧街，周五晚上 2 号线末班车 23:00 左右，错过就打车 25: Nanjing's densest bar street. Friday night the last Line 2 train is around 23:00. Miss it and a taxi is 25 yuan.
孝陵卫站上车 6 站直达，出校门走 5 分钟: Board at Xiaolingwei. 6 stops, no transfer. 5-minute walk from the gate.
2 号线到新街口换 1 号线，或到大行宫换 3 号线: Line 2 to Xinjiekou, then Line 1. Or get off at Daxinggong and switch to Line 3.
往下马坊方向骑，中山陵免票，明孝陵学生半价，樱花季人多得走不动: Bike toward Xiamafang. Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum is free. Ming Xiaoling is half price with a student ID. Cherry-blossom season, you can barely walk.
2 号线到新街口换 1 号线到南京南站再换 S1，行李多就打车，180 元左右: Line 2 to Xinjiekou, Line 1 to Nanjing South, then S1. With lots of luggage, take a taxi. About 180 yuan.
地铁 2 号线孝陵卫站在校门口，15 分钟到新街口，大校区里没有更好的位置: Line 2 Xiaolingwei is at the gate. 15 minutes to Xinjiekou. No large campus sits better.
背靠紫金山，中山陵、明孝陵、梅花山都是散步范围，三月的二月兰和梅花是全城的打卡点: Purple Mountain at your back. Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, Ming Xiaoling, and Plum Blossom Hill are walking distance. March February orchids and plum blossom are city-wide photo stops.
机械、材料、自动化的实验室条件好，工科研究生的科研资源充足: Labs for machinery, materials, and automation are strong. Engineering graduate research resources are solid.
宿舍区和教学区集中，校园虽大但日常生活半径小: Dorms and teaching blocks sit together. The campus is large, but daily life stays in a small radius.
兵器、武器系统等涉及国防的专业不对留学生开放，选专业前必须核对国际教育学院的清单: Weapons, weapons systems, and other defense majors are closed to international students. Check the School of International Education list before you pick a major.
开放的专业里中文授课占多数，全英文项目远少于东大和河海: Most open majors are Chinese-taught. Far fewer English-taught programs than SEU or Hohai.
留学生规模在南京的 211 里偏小，国际生圈子不大，靠自己出去混: The international cohort is small for a Nanjing 211. The circle is small. You have to go out and mix.
留学生公寓楼新旧差别大，分到老楼就没电梯，夏天顶楼很热: International dorms vary a lot by age. An old building means no elevator. Top floor is hot in summer.
哪些专业留学生不能报？: Which majors are closed to international students?
涉及兵器、武器系统、部分材料和信息安全方向的专业不招留学生，实验室也进不去。国际: Majors in weapons, weapons systems, some materials, and information security do not take international students. You also don't get into those labs. The School of International Education's program list each year is the only authority. Don't trust old pages online.
二月兰到底什么时候开？: When do the February orchids actually bloom?
一般 3 月下旬到 4 月中旬，清明前后最盛。开花的两个周末校园会限流，外校的人: Usually late March to mid-April. Peak around Qingming. On the two bloom weekends the campus caps visitors. Outsiders need a reservation. Your campus card still gets you in anytime.
不会中文能读中文授课的专业吗？: Can you study a Chinese-taught major without Chinese?
不建议。学校要求 HSK 4 起，实际上课 HSK 5 以下会很吃力。先读一年汉: Not recommended. The school asks for HSK 4. In class, below HSK 5 is a grind. A common path is one year of Chinese, then the major. Language classes are on the same campus.
孝陵卫和钟灵街一带一居室 2200-3200 元，走路到校门 10 分钟内，是南: Studios around Xiaolingwei and Zhongling Street run 2200-3200 yuan. Walk to the gate in under 10 minutes. Rare combo in central Nanjing: cheap and near the metro. Register at the police station within 24 hours of signing.
MBBS 基本是自费项目，奖学金很少；硕博和少数成绩靠前的 MBBS 学生能拿到: MBBS is mostly self-funded. Scholarships are scarce. Master's, PhD, and a few top MBBS students can get the Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship or a university award.
MBBS 秋季入学 3 月至 7 月，硕博 CSC 项目 1 月至 4 月: MBBS fall intake: March to July. Master's and PhD CSC programs: January to April.
南医大的留学生几乎全是六年制 MBBS，全程英文授课，印度、巴基斯坦、尼泊尔、孟: Almost all NJMU internationals are on the six-year MBBS, taught in English the whole way. Students from India, Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh, and Africa make up about 90%. Preclinical years are on Jiangning campus. Clinical classes and clerkships are at affiliated hospitals such as Jiangsu Province Hospital and Nanjing First Hospital. The timetable is 8am to 5pm every day. Miss too much class and you lose exam rights. The gate is Line 1 "NJMU · Jiangsu Institute of Commerce". 50 minutes to Xinjiekou. No transfer, but 17 stops.
MBBS 学生进附属医院见习前还要交乙肝五项和疫苗接种记录，体检时顺手加做，省得: Before hospital clerkship, MBBS students also need the five hepatitis B tests and vaccination records. Add them at the health check so you don't make a second trip in the clinical years.
大学城的学生街，奶茶、水果、小饭馆，晚上十点收摊: University-town student street. Milk tea, fruit, small restaurants. Stalls close at 10pm.
MBBS 低年级基本住校，住校外要先向国际教育学院备案。: MBBS underclassmen mostly live on campus. Off-campus housing needs a filing with the School of International Education first.
十来所学校的学生街，比南医大门口热闹一档: A student street for about ten schools. One notch busier than NJMU's gate.
地铁 1 号线两站，或骑车 15 分钟: Line 1, two stops. Or 15 minutes by bike.
江宁最成熟的商圈，商场、电影院、健身房: Jiangning's most built-out commercial area. Mall, cinema, gym.
早八的课要六点半起床。: An 8am class means 6:30 out of bed.
有清真窗口，MBBS 学生是主力客户，阿姨会说 chicken、beef、no: Halal window. MBBS students are the main customers. The auntie says chicken, beef, no pork.
校门外沿街: Along the street outside the gate
MBBS 群体养出了几家 biryani 和咖喱店，能用英语点单，周末聚餐默认地: The MBBS crowd keeps a few biryani and curry shops alive. You can order in English. Default weekend hangout.
日用品够，香料、扁豆、印度米要靠淘宝和微信里的南亚食材群。: Daily goods are covered. Spices, lentils, and Indian rice come from Taobao and South Asian grocery WeChat groups.
期末前两周晚上十点还满座，MBBS 的人抱着 Guyton 一坐一天。: The two weeks before finals, it's full at 10pm. MBBS people sit all day with Guyton.
校区旁的附属三甲，带教老师就在这，看病比市区快得多；急诊 24 小时。: Affiliated Grade-A tertiary hospital next door. Your teaching doctors are here. Faster than going downtown. ER 24 hours.
板球和足球场周末被南亚和非洲同学分了时段，健身房刷卡免费。: Cricket and football pitches are time-shared on weekends by South Asian and African students. Gym is free with your card.
解剖课之间的 15 分钟就靠这杯，美式 12 元。: The 15 minutes between anatomy labs run on this cup. Americano 12 yuan.
取件码在短信里，寄回国的行李找顺丰国际，医学书太重建议海运。: Pickup code is in the SMS. For luggage home, use SF International. Med textbooks are heavy. Sea freight is the move.
25 元学生价，剪头前把想要的发型照片存好。: Student price 25 yuan. Save a photo of the cut you want before you sit down.
扫码 5 元一次，白大褂别和牛仔裤一起洗，会染色。: Scan to pay, 5 yuan a load. Don't wash lab coats with jeans. They bleed.
南医大·江苏经贸学院站上车，1 号线直达不用换乘，但要坐 17 站: Board at NJMU · Jiangsu Institute of Commerce station. Line 1 straight through, no transfer, but 17 stops.
临床阶段的主战场，在鼓楼区广州路，1 号线进城换 2 号线；高年级很多人干脆搬到: The clinical-year base. Guangzhou Road, Gulou District. Line 1 into town, then Line 2. A lot of seniors just move downtown.
1 号线到南京南站换 S1；打车 25 分钟，80 元左右: Line 1 to Nanjing South, then S1. Taxi is 25 minutes, about 80 yuan.
MBBS 六年全英文授课，教材、考试、行政通知都是英文，不会中文也能顺利毕业: MBBS is six years, taught in English. Textbooks, exams, and admin notices are English. You can graduate without Chinese.
附属医院多，省人民医院、市第一医院都是三甲，临床见习的病例量巨大: Lots of affiliated hospitals. Jiangsu Province Hospital and Nanjing First Hospital are both Grade-A tertiary. Clerkship case volume is huge.
南亚和非洲学生的社群成熟，开学有老生带，排灯节和开斋节都有人组织: South Asian and African communities are established. Seniors meet you at the start. Diwali and Eid get organized.
江宁校区新，宿舍标配空调独卫，生活成本是南京最低一档: Jiangning campus is new. Dorms come with air-con and a private bath. Living costs are among the lowest in Nanjing.
课表每天早八晚五，出勤率低于要求直接取消考试资格，没有「翘课」这个选项: Timetable is 8am to 5pm every day. Drop below the attendance line and you lose exam rights. Skipping class is not an option.
回国后的执业资格考试（印度的 FMGE、巴基斯坦的 PMDC 考试等）学校不负责: Licensing exams back home (India's FMGE, Pakistan's PMDC, and the rest) are not the school's job. Pass or fail is on you.
临床阶段要跟着中国医生查房，病人不会说英文，毕业前 HSK 4 是硬要求: In the clinical years you round with Chinese doctors. Patients don't speak English. HSK 4 before graduation is a hard rule.
校区在江宁南部，进新街口 50 分钟，前两年基本围着校园转: Campus is in south Jiangning. 50 minutes to Xinjiekou. The first two years you mostly orbit campus.
MBBS 学费和住宿一年多少？: What do MBBS tuition and housing cost per year?
学费 3 万多一年，以录取通知书为准；双人间宿舍约 1000 元一个月，加保险: Tuition is a bit over 30,000 yuan a year. Trust the admission notice. A double dorm is about 1,000 yuan a month, plus 800 insurance and 538 for the health check. Safest first-year cash buffer is about 50,000 yuan.
毕业后回国能直接行医吗？: Can you practice medicine at home right after graduation?
不能直接。印度要过 FMGE（正在向 NExT 过渡），巴基斯坦要过 PMDC: Not automatically. India needs FMGE (moving to NExT). Pakistan needs the PMDC exam. Nepal and Bangladesh each have their own licensing tests. The school gives transcripts and attestation papers. Study and registration are on you. Start in year five.
每节课点名，缺勤超过规定比例直接取消该门课的考试资格，重修要交费。请假必须提前走: Every class takes attendance. Cross the absence cap and you lose exam rights for that course. Retakes cost money. Leave has to go through the School of International Education in advance. Makeup leave after the fact almost never goes through.
临床阶段住哪里？: Where do you live in the clinical years?
见习实习在市区的附属医院，往返江宁单程一小时以上，很多人这个阶段搬到医院附近合租: Clerkships and internships are at affiliated hospitals downtown. Jiangning one-way is over an hour. A lot of people move into a shared flat near the hospital at this stage. Housing changes year to year. Trust the School of International Education notice. Ask seniors early.
必须先在微信公众号「江苏国际旅行卫生保健中心」预约：业务办理 → 业务预约 →: Book first on the WeChat account "Jiangsu International Travel Healthcare Center": Services → Appointment → Entry-Exit health check. No ticket, no service. Come on an empty stomach.
周一至周五 9:00-17:30（河西接待大厅，法定节假日除外）: Mon-Fri 9:00-17:30 (Hexi reception hall, except public holidays)
南京有多个出入境受理点，去哪一个取决于学校和住址，不要默认是这一个。办理前用「我: Nanjing has several Exit-Entry offices. Which one you use depends on your school and address. Don't assume it's this one. Check slots and book in the My Nanjing app.
南航把学生带到这个厅。当日办公时间官方页面未列出。: NUAA sends students to this hall. Same-day hours are not listed on the official page.
江宁校区的学生可能走这里，出发前问国际处。当日办公时间官方页面未列出。: Jiangning-campus students may be sent here. Ask the international office before you go. Same-day hours are not listed on the official page.
公开来源只写仙林大学城内另有受理点，没有门牌。出发前问国际处。: Public sources only say there is another office inside Xianlin University Town. No street number. Ask the international office before you go.
南航将军路校区的住宿登记点。办公时间与是否预约未列出。网上办理与现场同等效力。: NUAA Jiangjun Road campus lodging-registration desk. Hours and whether you need an appointment are not listed. Online filing has the same legal effect as showing up.
报到、校园卡和保险窗口都在这个地址，具体窗口以当天指示为准。: Registration, campus card, and insurance windows are at this address. Follow the signs that day for the exact counter.
中国银行和工商银行对留学生最熟练，先问同学哪家支行常办。: Bank of China and ICBC handle international students most smoothly. Ask classmates which branch they actually use.
认准「营业厅」，路边摊卖的卡实名信息不是你的，后面绑不了支付宝。: Use a real carrier shop. Street-stall SIMs are not in your name. You won't bind Alipay later.
支付宝和微信都支持外国护照实名，姓名要和护照拼写完全一致。: Alipay and WeChat both accept foreign-passport real-name signup. The name must match the passport spelling exactly.
